def build(p):
    R = p.disk_radius + p.wall
    # Solid back at z=0, open front at z=box_depth. Print back-down so all interior is upward-opening.
    box = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(R).extrude(p.box_depth)
    # interior cavity: from just above back to the front
    inner = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.disk_radius).translate((0,0,p.back_thick)).extrude(p.box_depth - p.back_thick)
    box = box.cut(inner)

    # Front lip recess to seat the disk flush: disk bottom sits at z=box_depth-disk_t, lip below it
    disk_seat_z = p.box_depth - p.disk_t - p.disk_lip_h
    seat = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.disk_radius + p.disk_lip_t).translate((0,0,disk_seat_z)).extrude(p.disk_lip_h)
    box = box.cut(seat)
    # keep inner lip: cut a smaller radius up to seat so disk rests on a ring
    ring = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.disk_radius - p.disk_lip_t).translate((0,0,disk_seat_z)).extrude(p.disk_lip_h)
    box = box.cut(ring)

    # Two M3 bosses on the front face for the disk's centre holes
    boss = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(6)
    for x in (-p.disk_hole_radius, p.disk_hole_radius):
        b = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(6/2).extrude(p.disk_lip_h)
        b = b.translate((x, 0, disk_seat_z))
        box = box.union(b)
    # tap holes
    for x in (-p.disk_hole_radius, p.disk_hole_radius):
        box = box.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.m3_self_tap_d/2).translate((x,0,disk_seat_z)).extrude(p.disk_lip_h + 2))

    # Perfboard mounting bosses on the back inside face
    px = p.perf_l/2 - p.perf_hole_inset - p.perf_hole_d/2
    py = p.perf_w/2 - p.perf_hole_inset - p.perf_hole_d/2
    for xx in (-px, px):
        for yy in (-py, py):
            box = box.union(cq.Workplane('XY').circle(5/2).translate((xx,yy,0)).extrude(p.back_thick + 6))
            box = box.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.m3_self_tap_d/2).translate((xx,yy,0)).extrude(p.back_thick+6))

    # USB-C opening through the front lip (top side, +y): a slot in the front rim
    # port centre x offset, y at top of disk
    usb_y = p.disk_radius - p.wall + 2
    slot = cq.Workplane('XY').box(p.usb_port_w + 2, 8, centered=True).translate((0, usb_y, p.box_depth - p.disk_lip_h - p.usb_port_h/2)).extrude(10)
    box = box.cut(slot)

    # Keyhole slots in the back for wall hanging (two, symmetric about x)
    for hx in (-p.hang_inset, p.hang_inset):
        hole = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.hang_d/2).translate((hx,0,-1)).extrude(p.back_thick+2)
        box = box.cut(hole)

    return box
